verdicts.reason: I scored both candidates 2 out of 5. B is the less bad of the two because it keeps the original's centred structure and a large orange CTA, but it has real faults. In A, the dark header has become a huge empty square that takes up the left half of the canvas, and the logo is shrunk to a speck in its corner. A's orange divider floats with no clear purpose, and the 'Reserve a Case' button is tiny and buried bottom-left next to 'Ships late June', so the hierarchy and the original feel are lost. In B, the orange divider strikes through the body copy ('our seaside'), which is a clear collision. B's logo is also shrunk to an illegible dot in the thin header bar. The headline, body, button and legal text are all jammed together with almost no breathing room.
